description: This is a C source file implementing a QR code generator demo, including functions to generate and print QR codes with various configurations and data.

methods.name: doBasicDemo
methods.description: Generates and prints a basic QR code with 'Hello, world!' text.

methods.name: doVarietyDemo
methods.description: Generates and prints various QR codes with different data types and encoding modes.

methods.name: doSegmentDemo
methods.description: Demonstrates creating QR codes with manually specified segments for better data encoding.

methods.name: doMaskDemo
methods.description: Generates QR codes with different mask patterns for the same data.

methods.name: printQr
methods.description: Prints the QR code to the console with a border.
